title: Exfoliable 1D chalcogenide chains: archived DFT, GW and BSE results (Grillo et al., ACS Nano 2026)

k_points.note: irreducible points of a 48-point grid along the chain; k_frac in units of 2*pi/c

levels.scGW: last archived iteration of eigenvalue self-consistent GW, G and W updated (o-G3W3.qp; o-G4W4.qp for As2S3)

qp.returns: all archived bands at those k-points (Eo, E-Eo, Sc|Eo) and the Yambo run header

bse_spectrum.returns: the archived Haydock spectrum (0-10 eV, field along the chain) with its Yambo header; run names are the authors' labels

dft_bands.returns: archived PBE bands along Gamma-Z (301 points), computed with or without spin-orbit coupling, bands near the gap

wire_screening.returns: DFPT electronic dielectric tensor of the supercell, cells and the Environ quantum-volume record

withheld_for_grading: qp of Bi2Te3 at the scGW level
methods: PBE with Quantum ESPRESSO; GW and BSE with Yambo 5.2.3 (plasmon-pole GW, cylindrical Coulomb cutoff, random-integration method; BSE in the Tamm-Dancoff approximation solved by the Haydock method with 5 meV damping, light polarized along the chain). Isolated chains in periodic supercells with vacuum perpendicular to the chain. The headers returned with each purchase record the run parameters.
